title: Examples manifest check result
description: Diff of the target tree's examples/ against examples_manifest.yaml. Always produced; never fails the job.

target_repo.description: Repository whose examples/ was scanned, owner/name.

target_ref.description: Branch, tag, or SHA that was scanned.

new_paths.description: Example paths present on disk but missing from the manifest.

stale_paths.description: Example paths listed in the manifest but missing on disk.

supported.description: Manifest entries that CI will run. The run-example job schedules runner, devices, container image, timeout, and setup profile from these entries, so those fields are required. overlay_args and exec are optional: overlay_args only when the command needs CI-scale overrides; exec only when path is not the file to launch (for example a CMake example directory).

path.description: Example identity in the target tree. A file or a directory.

exec.description: File to launch after setup, relative to the target root. When omitted, run_example.sh launches path.

overlay_args.description: CLI argument overrides appended to the launched process (path, or exec when set). Each item is one or more shell tokens; $VAR / ${VAR} expand at run time.
